messages.author: 4b06c0bae2d1991d
messages.subject: version bump compatibility
parts:
is the version bump to 1.14 not reverse-compatible with previous code? I'm getting the follow error in a previously-run RData file now that I've upgraded the version:
summary(uniDim) 
Error in .local(object, ...) : 
  no slot of name "Options" for this object of class "SingleGroupClass"

Thanks,
Aaron

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: version bump compatibility
parts:
Hi Aaron,

That's correct, one major thing that was changed was how the objects are organized internally (https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt/blob/master/NEWS.md). Another useful function is now extract.mirt() to more easily extract elements from the objects. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Phil
